title: AgEcon IrrigationYieldPanel

stats.done_summary: Completed agricultural economics analysis of irrigation program outcomes using plot-year panel data. Key findings: (1) Groundwater quota enforcement has a strong positive effect on yields (β=1.89, p<0.001), (2) High enforcement areas achieve 20.7% higher yields while using 14.6% less irrigation water, (3) Policy-yield correlation (r=0.514) exceeds irrigation-yield correlation (r=0.308), suggesting effective water management policies enhance efficiency. Generated 7 figures and comprehensive regression analysis. Report saved to report/report.md.
